collection.title: Lotus Evora 2009 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Lotus Evora 2009 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
